title: Cinematic 3D title (Three.js)
description: A generative 3D world under a slow camera, ending on a title. Terrain: a seeded mountain valley at golden hour, dawn or dusk with baked long shadows, a reflective river, layered haze and drifting clouds; the camera flies low along the river and climbs over a far ridge to reveal the low sun. Planet: an orbital sunrise over a procedurally textured planet (terran, dust or ice) with clouds, an atmosphere rim and star field; the sun breaks over the limb with a glare. A tracked title, accent rule and subtitle settle over a scrim measured from the rendered pixels for 4.5:1 contrast. Any aspect ratio.

world.description: terrain: valley flyover that climbs to reveal the sun; planet: orbital sunrise over a planet's limb

atmosphere.description: Terrain light: golden (warm low sun, blue sky), dawn (pink horizon, snow on the peaks), dusk (deep orange, violet shadows)

planet.description: Planet surface: terran (oceans, land, clouds, blue rim), dust (rust desert, thin warm haze), ice (pale bands and ice, cyan rim)

title.description: Title set large in the lower middle of the frame

subtitle.default: A journey through the northern valleys
subtitle.description: Line under the title (empty for none)

kicker.description: Small tracked line above the title, e.g. a series or episode label (empty for none)

title_style.description: tracked: medium uppercase with wide letter spacing (film title); bold: heavy sentence case

palette.description: Ink (title and subtitle; a scrim is added under it when the scene behind is too bright) and accent (rule and kicker)

speed.description: Drift speed after the main move has landed

msaa.description: Multisample anti-aliasing (off renders faster for drafts)

alpine-dawn.title: Above the Clouds
alpine-dawn.subtitle: Seven days on the high route

dusk-valley.title: Where the River Bends
dusk-valley.subtitle: Stories from the last ferry town

orbit-sunrise.title: Pale Blue Dot
orbit-sunrise.subtitle: How small we are, and how rare

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`; renders on software WebGL (SwiftShader).
The terrain, planet surface, clouds and stars are generated from spec.seed: change the seed for a different landscape.
Beats (D = duration): exposure rises over 0.9 s; the sun clears the ridge or limb at about 0.46D; title 0.56D; subtitle 0.66D; camera move lands at 0.62D, then drifts.
Uses the system's Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.
Measured on software WebGL (SwiftShader) at 1080x1920, 30 fps, including setup: about 6.6 s per output second for terrain and 3.9 s for planet.
